# Notchscape 2.9.3 (296) — New repository and update destination
The active project and new releases move to [graden-grech/Notchscape-app](https://github.com/graden-grech/Notchscape-app), a new standalone repository with fresh history. The app remains **Notchscape**.
- New builds check the new repository's signed Sparkle feed. - Existing Notchscape feeds provide the signed migration update, while older release/download URLs remain available. - App/helper signing identity, update key, saved settings and permissions remain the same. Accounts remain disabled. - Includes the optional six-chapter setup with Skip/Back/Next and replay from General or Help; 24 White House scene combinations; red/blue and Christmas icons; improved header spacing; and the earlier features. - New users start with Weather off and Show on all displays on. Existing users' explicit and old implicit settings are retained.
Requires Apple silicon and macOS 15 or later; native Liquid Glass requires macOS 26. The app is Apple Development signed, not Developer ID signed or notarized. The unsigned installer preview is not distributed. Full other-OS, hardware/DisplayLink, fresh-account permissions and accessibility/performance coverage remain incomplete.
Published archive hashes, source revision, independent signature verification, hosted CI and real updater/HUD outcomes are recorded separately in the release's verification assets. A source push alone does not establish those results. See [migration details](https://github.com/graden-grech/Notchscape-app/blob/v2.9.3/docs/NEW_REPOSITORY_MIGRATION.md) and [distribution readiness](https://github.com/graden-grech/Notchscape-app/blob/v2.9.3/docs/DISTRIBUTION_READINESS.md). Original-source licenses and notices are preserved.

# Notchscape 2.9.2 — Guided setup and White House
- Optional six-chapter setup explains every public Settings section, with Back, Next and Skip. Replay it from General settings or Help. - Permission connections are grouped on one optional page. Calendar and Reminders request access only when you choose Connect, with the current macOS purpose strings. Skipped setup stays skipped on relaunch. - White House includes 24 room, color and Christmas scenes: four views, neutral/red/blue décor, and festive versions with snow outside. - Four matching icons: Republican red, Democrat blue, and a Christmas version of each. Match the theme automatically or choose any icon manually. - Better full-photo previews, aligned theme cards and Home framing. Expanded Mirror, Settings and Battery controls have space below the screen edge. - Weather starts off and Show on all displays starts on for new users. Existing settings, signing identity, HUD permissions and updater key are preserved. Accounts remain disabled.
Requires Apple silicon and macOS 15 or later, matching the linked music framework. Native Liquid Glass needs macOS 26; earlier supported systems use standard materials. Install Notchscape.app in shared /Applications to make the app available to other local accounts; settings, privacy access and login startup remain separate for each account.
Development-signed, not Developer ID signed or notarized. The unsigned installer preview is not included. The complete fresh-account, macOS, hardware, DisplayLink and accessibility/performance matrix is not fully verified. See the [release verification and limits](https://github.com/graden-grech/Notchscape/blob/v2.9.2/docs/releases/2.9.2.md).

item.title: Notchscape 2.9.1
item.description:
# Notchscape 2.9.1 — Complete product branding
- Fresh downloads contain Notchscape.app with a Notchscape executable and matching helper product name. - Project/source folders, onboarding, About, localized labels and installer names use Notchscape. - Removes unused old logos and welcome audio. Legal notices remain in the Legal section. - Restart opens the exact current app instead of resolving an older duplicate. - Keeps existing settings, app/helper signing identity and update key. Accounts remain disabled.
Existing installations: Sparkle preserves the installed app's filename. After updating, quit and rename that installed copy to Notchscape.app once if it retains an older filename. Keep one installed copy; do not reset permissions or delete settings. Fresh downloads are already named correctly.
Development-signed, not notarized; this is a branding correction, not a claim of full production readiness. Apple silicon only; native Liquid Glass needs macOS 26. macOS 14 compatibility, other hardware, external-display/DisplayLink and the complete fresh-device permission matrix remain unverified. The new White House theme is a separate follow-up, not part of this archive.

item.title: Notchscape 2.9.0
item.description:
# Notchscape 2.9.0 — Workspace, capture and appearance
- Commands search, calculator/conversions, encrypted snippets, Quicklinks and saved colors. - Stopwatch/laps, focus cycles, Keep Awake and pinned event countdowns. - Capture Studio: markup/redaction, optional searchable library, QR/barcodes, explicit silent recording, trimming and MP4/M4A/GIF export. - Window positioning/Undo, saved layouts and app/window switching with optional one-shot previews. - Preferred audio outputs, input selection, supported hardware mute and accessory low-battery alerts. - Additional watched download folders, pinned notes, Finder Services and Apple Shortcuts actions. - Network/disk/memory-pressure stats, saved appearance presets and six new static palette scenes. - Includes the AI chat-title fix. Existing settings, signing identity, HUD permissions and update key are preserved. Accounts remain disabled.
New capture/routing/alert actions are explicit or opt-in. Recording is silent and selected with Apple's picker. A real music Up Next queue remains unavailable. Requires Apple silicon/macOS 14; recording needs macOS 15 and native Liquid Glass needs macOS 26. Development-signed, not notarized. Hardware, multi-display, other macOS versions and the complete live export/appearance/permission matrix are not fully verified. See the release notes and feature tracker for limits.

item.title: Notchscape 2.8.5
item.description:
# Notchscape 2.8.5 — AI chat names
- AI activities show matching chat names instead of `/` or folder labels when local title metadata is available. - Click the compact AI activity to reveal its chat title. Readable fallbacks are used if a provider has no title. - Exact-session matching, background lookups, bounded reads and short-lived caching; no provider data is changed or uploaded. - Existing preferences, HUD permissions, signing identity and update key are preserved. Accounts remain disabled.
This focused release excludes the larger unfinished workspace-tools, capture, window-management and theme feature batch. Development-signed; not notarized. Requires Apple silicon and macOS 14 or later; native Liquid Glass requires macOS 26. Other hardware/macOS versions and fresh-device permission flows remain unverified.

# boringNotch Custom 2.8.4
- No account required: Continue Without an Account skips account setup. Sign-in, account pages, passkeys and cloud sync stay disabled; existing saved credentials and cloud settings are not deleted. - A release check keeps unfinished account features disabled. The earlier account preview remains withdrawn. - The optional lock-screen Home dropdown shows only a lock inside the expanded menu, with no closed-notch badge or explanatory text. - External-display visibility can be turned off, with dependent controls clearly disabled. - Lighter Settings surfaces and a clearer terminal symbol for AI activity.
The lock-screen option remains experimental, off by default, and uses inherited private SkyLight integration rather than an official Apple extension. Development-signed with the existing app/helper identity and update key; not notarized. Requires Apple silicon and macOS 14 or later; native Liquid Glass requires macOS 26. Fresh-device onboarding, other macOS versions, full VoiceOver coverage, multiple displays/DisplayLink, rapid lock transitions and permission revocation remain unverified.

# boringNotch Custom 2.8.3
- Bounded HUD recovery after launch, activation, and wake, with no permanent watchdog. - Accurate interceptor status, a Restart HUD control, and permission monitoring that survives closing Settings. - Stale event-tap cleanup and recovery that respects the user's HUD on/off choice. - Matching 30-point native glass capsules for the Home battery, Mirror, and Settings controls. Small native switches stay unchanged. - Signed-build identity checks and a live HUD smoke test to catch future regressions.
Uses the same signing identity and update key. Development-signed; not notarized. Requires Apple silicon and macOS 14 or later; native Liquid Glass requires macOS 26. Full sleep/wake, permission-revocation, VoiceOver, and external-display/DisplayLink testing remain pending.

# boringNotch Custom 2.8.2
- Optional Enhanced battery controls, real local history, and brief optional battery alerts. Original style remains available. - Battery glass stays inside the Home header, including when charging. - Small native Apple switches with Liquid Glass and drag interaction on macOS 26. - Lighter content materials, improved settings scrolling and resizing, and better accessibility for media, Mirror, Shelf, and opening the menu. - Home widget ordering, Quick Actions, local AI outcome history, and battery-conscious rendering modes. - Refined seasonal backgrounds, inclusive Winter theme, manual or theme-matched app icons, and custom accents. - Improved Dock visibility and opt-in setup for inherited publishing workflows.
Development-signed; not notarized. Requires Apple silicon and macOS 14 or later. Native Liquid Glass requires macOS 26. Full external-display/DisplayLink, VoiceOver, onboarding permission-dialog, and HUD permission/restart regression tests remain pending.

# boringNotch Custom 2.8.1
- Choose Dynamic Island or Notch for notchless displays. - Seasonal themes and matching icons, including a full-sized Christmas tree beside the Home calendar. - Sports favorites, compact scores, and score notifications. - Improved AI quota handling: low-usage warnings stay active and quota failures cannot turn into completion checks. - Native Liquid Glass on macOS 26 with lighter fallbacks on older macOS. - Fewer AI redraws and paused music timers for better efficiency.
Physical-notch and DisplayLink hardware validation and the full HUD restart regression remain pending. Developer-signed; not notarized.

# boringNotch Custom 2.8.0
- Shows a single Apple-style green completion check on one side of the notch. - Detects AI usage and rate limits, shows a red three-second alert, and clears abandoned working states automatically. - Adds an optional System tab with efficient, on-demand CPU, memory, storage, and thermal-pressure monitoring plus safe Mac controls. - Adds rounded rectangle, squircle, and capsule mirror shapes. - Introduces a new Liquid Glass app icon, native Apple Liquid Glass navigation and music controls, plus translucent Settings, Live, System, and Shelf surfaces. - Replaces the separate top buttons with a compact Apple-style segmented control and removes the stray pressed-symbol animation from music controls. - Keeps the HUD enabled across launches and rebuilds, automatically restarts its media-key interceptor after Accessibility approval, and uses a stable local signing identity so macOS keeps the permission grant. - Removes costly activation-policy switching when Settings opens and closes, making the custom Settings window significantly smoother. - Keeps Sparkle automatic updates on the public `graden-grech/boringNotch-custom` GitHub feed.
- Adds Codex and Claude Code activities with provider colors, Music/AI priority, dual-activity layouts, and four-second completion indicators. - Adds a location-aware weather tile that can live on Home or the Live page. - Restores native notch sizing when weather is on the Live page and keeps the calendar at its normal size. - Adds Live Activity controls, timers, download status, calendar alerts, and Apple-style privacy indicators. - Improves the HUD permission flow and keeps the original rounded notch shape. - Refines the AI completion checkmark and music waveform with a cleaner, Apple-like appearance. - Moves Sparkle updates to the public `graden-grech/boringNotch-custom` feed.
